name: hyb_r10
rationale: Raw +20% short stop also fires when a coin rallies with BTC; that move is already offset by the BTC hedge, so the exit (and ban) is wasted cost. Require the beta-adjusted residual move since entry to be >=10% too. Differs from drawdown/T13-15 (pure residual stop, all failed): raw stop kept as the trigger, residual only a filter.

name: hyb_r15
rationale: as A01 with a stricter residual filter

name: vz3
rationale: A fixed 20% is ~1 sd for the jumpiest shorts and ~3 sd for calmer ones, and it ignores holding time. Stop on residual z: resid cum >= k*idio336*sqrt(max(hours held,24)); replaces the raw stop. Differs from drawdown/T39 (fixed per-name level set at rebalance, raw price).

name: vz4
rationale: as A03

name: vz3_plus_raw
rationale: Keep the raw 20% stop (it protects vs market-wide alt squeezes) and ADD the residual z=3 stop for idiosyncratic squeezes on calmer names.

name: half_15_25
rationale: Partial de-risking: halve at +15%, rest at +25%. Squeeze outcomes are bimodal; a ladder averages the exit price between the continuation and reversal branches. drawdown/T16 tried 10/20 (t 0.21); this brackets 20 symmetrically.

name: half_20_30
rationale: as A06 shifted out

name: trail20
rationale: Trailing stop on shorts from the lowest price since entry: a short that has already paid and then rips +x% off the low is a squeeze in progress; protect open profit. Fixed 20% from entry kept.

name: trail25
rationale: as A08

name: trail30
rationale: as A08

name: rankS30
rationale: Hourly exit on rank deterioration: if a held short falls out of the top-k jumpy names mid-period, its reason to be held is gone; exit now rather than at the next 8h rebalance (entries stay 8-hourly, so no extra noisy entries - the failure mode of faster re-ranking). k=30 = hysteresis keep band.

name: rankS40
rationale: as A11 with k=2N=40

name: rankL24
rationale: Same hourly rank exit for longs: exit a long that leaves the calmest 2N=24 names.

name: time3
rationale: Time stop: a position still under water after K days has shown the signal is not working for this name (disposition effect in reverse); exit (both legs).

name: time7
rationale: as A14

name: sqz_z3
rationale: Squeeze detector: a short with a 4h residual move > 3 sd AND 4h volume > 3x its normal 4h volume is in a volume-confirmed squeeze (forced short covering); exit before the price stop and ban until next rebalance. Hourly data <= i only.

name: sqz_z4
rationale: as A16 with z=4

name: redeploy_next
rationale: Capital freed by a stop sits idle until the next rebalance (up to 8h), lowering short gross; immediately re-deploy it into the next-ranked eligible short to keep the alpha leg fully invested.

name: redeploy_scale
rationale: Alternative: scale up the remaining shorts pro rata (no new name, no single-name selection at an off-cycle hour).

name: lc_reset
rationale: Stop measured from the last rebalance price (live measures from entry). A long-held short already +15% since entry has a hair-trigger stop; resetting at each re-rank tests whether the stop should be about new adverse moves only.

name: brake3
rationale: Book-level brake: if the short leg loses 3% of gross within one 8h period (correlated alt squeeze), halve the book until the next rebalance. Targets the Mar-2021 type event that single-name stops cannot catch.

name: brake5
rationale: as A21

name: confirm2
rationale: Stop confirmation: require the +20% condition on 2 consecutive hourly closes. Squeeze wicks often mean-revert within an hour; this avoids selling the top of a wick at a cost of one more hour of exposure.

name: lstop20
rationale: Long stop variants (long stop is 40% in B). The long leg is a beta offset; a tight long stop may cut calm names in crashes that the hedge already covers -> expect worse, but user asks about -20% positions so test it.

name: lstop30
rationale: as A24

name: lstop_off
rationale: as A24 (no long stop)

name: noban
rationale: Recovery diagnostic (written before this trial): a short at -20% has median +2-4% reversion over 24-72h but a fat continuation tail. The stop keeps the tail-cut; dropping the ban lets the book re-short the name at the next rebalance if it still ranks (bans of 24-168h were already tested in drawdown/T10-12 and failed; this is the other direction).

name: sstop15
rationale: Plateau check of B's short stop (0.15 never tested): is -20% the right cut level? Tighter = cut earlier in the continuation.

name: sstop25
rationale: as A28 on the other side (0.25 never tested)

name: reb_dw10
rationale: Continuation at the next-rebalance horizon (mean -1% to next reb after a -20% hit): at each rebalance, halve kept shorts already >=10% adverse since entry (still-ranked, not yet stopped), renormalising the short leg. Gentle, no extra trades between rebalances.

name: half_20_40
rationale: User-relevant partial cut: halve a short at -20%, keep the rest until the -40% (live) stop. Tests 'cut half now' vs B's 'cut all now'.

name: redeploy_next_8clock
rationale: Robustness of the best-t trial (A18): B's 8h clock is the best of 8 offsets (drawdown/run5), so compare A18 vs B averaged over all 8 rebalance clocks (partition test on the 8-clock average book).

name: sstop_8clock
rationale: Diagnostic, not a candidate: is the 20% short stop a robust optimum or a spike on one clock? Short stop 0.15/0.20/0.25/0.30 on all 8 clocks (SR only).
note: 0.20 best or within 0.07 of best on all 8 clocks; see clock.log
